color.$description: QuestUI theme-private palette. Resolved at build time and never emitted as CSS custom properties. Values come from the QuestUI design brief; the accessible text variants are documented in docs/DESIGN.md.

gold.$description: Primary gold: actions, highlights, glow borders.

parchment.$description: Warm text colors. Never pure white.

crimson.$description: Deep red: destructive actions, damage and error states.

royal.$description: Royal purple: rare items, lore and magic. The 300 step is the accessible text tint.

brown.$description: Layered brown surfaces. Never pure black.
